turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My rhubarb has these tall stalks with big frilly flower things on top. Is that okay?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's it trying to flower, which pulls energy away from the stalks. Cut the flower stems off at the base as soon as you see them.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I still eat the normal stalks?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes, they're fine. Pull them rather than cutting, give a little twist near the base.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: When should I stop picking? I've been

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Stop around early summer. The plant needs its leaves after that to build up strength for next year.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait a second, that doesn't sound right.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I'm fairly sure about it, but I could be wrong. What sounds off to you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the leaves, those are poisonous right?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes, don't eat the leaves. They're fine on the compost heap though.
